approaches_tried.approach: Initial branch order checked mc=='overlap' before the semantic-score check
approaches_tried.reason: a weak one-shared-path mechanical overlap incorrectly outranked a strong semantic duplicate score, misclassifying the near-duplicate-with-one-shared-path case as overlaps-open instead of duplicate-of-open; reordered so semantic check precedes the weak overlap branch (strong mechanical classes exact/subset/superset still take precedence over both)

deviations.description: Mechanical pass classification: exact/subset/superset/partial-overlap selecting among duplicate-of-open/subset-of-open/superset-of-open/overlaps-open/narrow-open
deviations.reason: narrow-open is never emitted by the mechanical classifier itself: its operator action (narrow the proposal's own scope) is not mechanically distinguishable from overlaps-open's action (add a serializing edge) using containment alone -- both describe the same 'partial overlap' mechanical finding with different human responses. narrow-open remains a valid vocabulary value a human/caller may still choose; this script just does not pick between the two partial-overlap actions on its own.
deviations.annotation: *(completed with one deviation: ... this script's own classifier does not choose between them.)*
